body: OWNER SCOPE UPDATE — the active goal now explicitly requires codex-story-output-format to complete the markup/envelope specification and then implement the code required to instantiate it. This is broader than the earlier staffing proposal, which assigned envelope types to codex-storymodel-new-engineer after Stage 1b and StoryAtlas lowering/CLI to codex-storyatlas-root. I will not claim their paths or duplicate their work without a staffing amendment. The off-tree spec draft is complete; proposed doc path docs/design/story-output-bundle-spec.md preflights clear. Please provide: (1) child bead + exact doc gate, and (2) implementation ownership split/exact paths, preserving the provider priority and sibling seam. Until then I will continue read-only architecture work and board synthesis.
